title: Pendulum Truck Timing Lab
description: A Rolex watch hangs from a crane arm as a massive pendulum bob, swinging above a track where a CesiumMilkTruck drives back and forth. The user must tune the pendulum length, truck speed, and release timing so the pendulum bob lands precisely in the truck bed, conserving momentum and energy across multiple coupled trials with undo/redo support.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a physics pendulum-catch lab. Load CesiumMilkTruck.glb as a truck driving along a straight ground track (Z-axis) and rolex.glb as a pendulum bob hanging from a visible cable (thin CylinderGeometry) attached to a fixed pivot point 6 units above the track. Camera: PerspectiveCamera at (10,8,10) looking at origin, with OrbitControls. Lighting: DirectionalLight plus AmbientLight, soft shadows on a ground plane.

Physics simulation: The Rolex pendulum swings in the XZ plane under gravity (g=9.81). Implement energy conservation: KE + PE = constant for the pendulum. The truck moves at a configurable constant velocity along Z.

UI panel (HTML overlay, top-left) with: (1) Pendulum Length slider (1-5 units), (2) Truck Speed slider (0.5-4 m/s), (3) Release Angle slider (-60 to 60 degrees), (4) Start Swing button to release pendulum from chosen angle, (5) Release Bob button to detach the Rolex at current swing position so it free-falls parabolically, (6) Launch Truck button to start truck moving, (7) Undo button and Redo button that revert/reapply the last parameter change or action. Maintain a state history stack for undo/redo (at least 14 states).

On release, the Rolex follows projectile motion preserving momentum. Detect collision with the truck bed bounding box. If caught, flash green outline and display 'CAUGHT! Momentum conserved.' with computed momentum values. If missed, flash red and show 'MISSED'. Display a real-time HUD showing: pendulum KE, PE, total energy, bob velocity vector, truck velocity, and trial count. After each trial, a Reset Trial button restores pendulum to pivot without resetting sliders. Track successful catches out of total attempts. The user needs to coordinate at least 10-14 interactions (adjust sliders, start swing, time the release, launch truck, undo mistakes, retry) to achieve a successful catch.
